errors.evidence: The blue line representing Bulgaria starts at approximately 24% in 2010, which is visibly below the 25% tick mark. Stating it starts at 26% is a significant overestimation.

errors.text_span: линията се стабилизира на около 33% през 2019 и 2020 година
errors.evidence: The value for Bulgaria in 2019 and 2020 is approximately 34.5%, which is very close to the 35% mark. The stated value of 33% is incorrect. Additionally, the description of the trend is inaccurate; the line dips in 2018 (to ~31%), rises in 2019 (to ~34.5%), and then stays flat in 2020.
The red line for EU-27 starts at approximately 38% in 2010, not 39%. The line is clearly below the halfway point between the 35% and 40% tick marks.
